plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai deterministic selector selected the Solutions nav button instead of Developers, navigating to a solutions page instead of docs.
observedIndicators: Deterministic cached instruction replayed selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' which matched the 'Solutions' button rather than 'Developers'.
Tool history confirms clicking 'Solutions' and navigating to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/'.
Live failure screenshot shows the 'Developers' navigation link is clearly present in the header.
Test code logic and assertion expecting 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/' are intact and correct.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run test suite
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI deterministic instruction cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run automation so Donobu can autonomously target the Developers menu item and regenerate fresh selectors.

plan.notes: The website's header layout shifted, causing structural CSS selectors (#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) in the deterministic cache to match the Solutions dropdown rather than Developers. Clearing the Page.AI cache will let autonomous execution find the Developers dropdown and Documentation link.
